answers.core: Developing addons is part of the core experience of Godot developers. Any person who intends to build an addon for the Godot editor will face the issues I have described above and I do not see how an addon could solve these problems.
answers.workaround: I do not know of any workaround for this. Please let me know in the comments if there is an easy way to debug addons that I might be unaware of!

title: Allow spawning a separate Godot instance to debug a specific plugin
